flags.message: The provisioned document set (documents.json, fetched 2026-07-18) carries only the petition and its QP section, while the 2026-09-17 snapshot shows a brief in opposition (Aug 31) and a reply (Sep 10) on the docket after a called-for response. The cell's documents were not refreshed to the snapshot date. In forward mode I fetched both briefs from supremecourt.gov and read them; a predictor that did not would have weighed the petition against no opposition. Also note context.distribution_count=2 counts the pre-CFR distribution plus the post-response redistribution; the petition has not yet been considered at conference, so the true relist count is 0.
